```python
import polars as pl

# Create example long-format data
df = pl.DataFrame({
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-02', '2024-01-02'],
    'city': ['NYC', 'LA', 'NYC', 'LA'],
    'temperature': [35, 72, 36, 73]
})

# Reshape to wide format
result = df.pivot(on='city', index='date', values='temperature')
print(result)
```
